units: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Dragon Ball-inspired production game sprite sheet for a top-down 2D territorial strategy game. Create ONE landscape transparent PNG containing EXACTLY 12 complete isolated sprites arranged in a STRICT 4-column by 3-row evenly spaced grid of equal cells. Each object centered, at most 55 percent of cell width and height, very generous transparent gutters, no overlap. Order LEFT TO RIGHT TOP TO BOTTOM: ROW 1: (1) compact white and blue Capsule Corporation-inspired hovercraft with a glass dome cockpit, usable as a transport boat; (2) chunky yellow and white capsule cargo hover-barge with two orange cargo pods; (3) white and purple Frieza-style military flying saucer, circular hull with four short dark landing prongs, seen from above, usable as a warship; (4) orange-gold ki blast with a short bright blue energy tail, a single compact projectile. ROW 2: (5) large blue-white Spirit Bomb sphere with crisp cyan energy arcs attached tightly to the sphere; (6) violet energy attack orb surrounded by exactly three small orange ki balls, replacing a splitting MIRV; (7) luminous golden Destructo Disc, tilted elliptical cutting energy disc; (8) tiny bright green ki bolt. ROW 3: (9) compact orange ki pellet with a pointed short trail; (10) white-blue futuristic capsule locomotive with a rounded blue canopy viewed from above; (11) matching empty white-blue capsule rail wagon viewed from above; (12) matching rail wagon loaded with orange Dragon Balls, subtle simple red star marks. Style: polished bright 2D cel-shaded anime game sprites inspired by Dragon Ball, bold black outlines, clean flat shapes, readable at tiny size, white and blue capsule technology, orange-gold energy, magenta-purple accents, consistent top-down orientation. Original fan-game artwork, no copied or extracted game assets. TRUE alpha transparency outside every solid sprite, no backdrop of any kind. No scenery, ground, drop shadows, fog, diffuse glow outside objects, lettering, logos, labels, grid lines, watermark, baked checkerboard. Every sprite complete with generous padding on all sides.
buildings: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original Dragon Ball-inspired BUILDING ICON sprite sheet for a top-down 2D territorial strategy game. Create ONE transparent PNG with EXACTLY SIX separate complete building icons, STRICT 3-column by 2-row evenly spaced equal-cell grid. Each single building centered in its cell, at most 55 percent of cell width and height, very large fully transparent gutters and outer margins. LEFT TO RIGHT TOP TO BOTTOM: ROW 1: (1) CITY = cluster of white rounded Capsule Corporation-style futuristic domed buildings, blue windows and a turquoise central dome, no lettering; (2) PORT = Kame House-inspired tiny pink seaside house with a red roof, one green palm tree and a short wooden dock attached to the house, no water backdrop; (3) FACTORY = compact red-and-white Red Ribbon-inspired robotics assembly factory, one squat chimney, yellow mechanical arm and a red cylindrical generator, no logos. ROW 2: (4) DEFENSE POST = Korin Tower-inspired ivory training tower, slim carved column ending in a small green-roofed round house, an attached solid circular foot for the icon; (5) SAM LAUNCHER = Kami's Lookout-inspired floating cream and gold circular platform with a small red-roofed temple and two tiny palms, no clouds; (6) MISSILE SILO = white Saiyan space-pod launch gantry, round white pod with an open dark-red window hatch and a short orange energy emitter on a small sturdy platform. Style: clean bright 2D cel-shaded anime icon art inspired by Dragon Ball, bold dark outlines, flat readable chunky shapes, white-blue technology, pink and red architecture, orange-gold accents, consistent gently top-down three-quarter icon view. NOT photorealistic and not a 3D render: no ambient occlusion, no smoky effects, no scenery. TRUE transparent alpha outside all solid objects including all margins and gutters; no drop shadow, no diffuse glow, no haze, no ground plane, no text, no lettering, no logos, no labels, no grid, no watermark, no baked checkerboard. Original fan-game artwork, no extracted game textures.
